inputs.prompt: Animate this exact hand-drawn Japanese 2D anime frame. Keep clean dark ink contours, flat matte skin, hard-edged two-tone cel shadows, broad drawn hair locks and painted blue gothic cathedral scenery in EVERY frame. Preserve the exact character identities, clothing, scale, architecture, colors, camera angle and composition. No 3D rendering, glossy plastic, realistic skin, dimensional fur, cuts, camera orbit, extra limbs, text, subtitles or new characters. A restrained dramatic anime shot, not a looping illustration. The small blue-haired girl in the blue whale hood stands at the left facing the black-and-gold robed priest at the right. His hand begins on her near shoulder. He gives ONE brief firm push away from himself, then immediately withdraws his hand. The girl recoils toward the left, bends both knees, loses her footing and catches herself with her palms on the stone floor. Her knees settle down and her weight is supported by her hands and knees; then she raises her head toward the departing priest. Clear anticipation, weight shift, fall, soft impact and settle. The priest remains upright at the right; his arm returns to his own side. No flying, kicking, elastic bouncing, repeated shoves or instant teleportation. Her hood, skirt and hair follow the movement with a slight delay. End with the girl low on the floor, looking up to the right.
